relevant_changes.change: max_projection_iters becomes a hard watchdog: exceeding it now ABORTS with projection_budget_exhausted=True, instead of silently continuing to max_iterations.
relevant_changes.relevance: Directly matches the saturating pathology measured in this repo: n_projections = 200.0/iteration against max_projection_iters=200, for all 8000 outer iterations, with no signal in 0.4.0 (results/feasibility_certificate.json). In 0.5.0+ this would surface immediately as projection_budget_exhausted instead of running silently to max_iterations.

relevant_changes.change: Constraint selection changed from raw-residual argmax to normalized-distance winner; box bounds folded into the same projection sweep as row constraints; feasibility assessment now 'joint' (rows + box) via SolverResult.joint_feasible / max_violation_rows_raw / max_distance_rows / max_violation_box.
relevant_changes.relevance: Potentially changes how a degenerate (exact-zero-norm) row like the k=0..4 gradient rows found in results/gradient_row_infeasibility.json is selected or reported -- not verified against this repo's QP; flagged 'potentially relevant', needs a compatibility test before adoption.

relevant_changes.change: New stationarity_residual field: NNLS-based KKT certificate quantifying distance from stationarity.

converged now defaults to a scale-invariant KKT-cone certificate: r_kkt <= kkt_abs_tol + kkt_rel_tol * max(||Ax||, ||b||, ||N^T mu||), invariant to positive objective rescaling / row order / row duplication / per-row scaling. ConvergenceConfig.optimality_test selects 'kkt' (default) | 'legacy_projected_gradient' | 'none'. use_projected_gradient / proj_grad_tol deprecated as constructor-only aliases.
relevant_changes.relevance: directly relevant -- this is exactly the convergence-certificate defect documented for this project: the installed 0.4.0 gates convergence on an ABSOLUTE proj_grad_tol=0.05 whose measured norm spans 2.2e1 (N=5) to 1.7e10 (N=20) on this problem (results/convergence_blocker_probe.json). A relative/scale-invariant test is the correct fix in principle; adoption requires re-running the saved stiff-step QP and confirming u0/objective/primal-residual are UNCHANGED before trusting the new flag (see the dependency-upgrade regression gate, tools/snn_opt_regression_baseline.py).

relevant_changes.change: SolverConfig.observe_projection_events (default off): per-row/coordinate committed projection counts.
relevant_changes.relevance: would have directly answered the n_projections=0 anomaly with an official instrumentation hook instead of the manual trace in tools/gradient_row_infeasibility_probe.py.
